# brainTrade Work Log

## 2026-08-28 13:14 UTC — [Pillar 4] Second range print persists while sentiment and transition chop veto

**Task:** Refresh the composite alpha pipeline and test whether the first range-reset print persists toward the three-print clearance requirement with supportive forward behavior.
**Finding:** BTC printed $79,357.66 and retained slow RANGE/TRADE plus fast RANGE/tradeable, extending `range_compression_setup` to a second consecutive range-friendly snapshot. Compression remained coiled at 0.7356, PM risk stayed medium, liquidation flow stayed neutral, and live clearance held at 8/11. The first reset print was -0.15% after 30 minutes with its 60-minute outcome pending. Historical broad reset sequences show third-plus prints at 18/28 positive over 60 minutes with +0.1012% mean and +0.0737% leave-best-out, but the stricter range-friendly scorer still has no completed three-plus-print cohort. Fear & Greed remains 73 at the 94.8th percentile (`euphoria_fade_watch`), and 48-hour classifier churn remains 16 transitions versus the below-four clearance rule.
**My thinking:** Persistence is progressing, but it has not completed the predeclared three-print gate and its current forward path is mildly adverse. More importantly, a third range print would clear only one of three blockers; elevated sentiment and extreme transition churn remain independent reasons to withhold alpha weight.
**Decision:** Classify `SECOND_RANGE_PRINT_PERSISTS_INDEPENDENT_BLOCKERS_REMAIN`; retain `BLOCK_LIVE`, keep the persistence count at two, and leave liquidation neutral with no confidence override. Make no confidence-score mutation, trade, live configuration change, or retired-bot restart.
**Next:** Score the third snapshot if range-friendly structure persists, settle the first print's 60-minute return, and require sentiment to exit euphoria-fade plus transition churn below four before any clearance review.

## 2026-08-28 12:59 UTC — [Pillar 3] CHIP clears acquisition gates but needs 79 hours to recover known costs

**Task:** Refresh the extreme-funding universe after the zero-candidate scan, measure both execution legs for any newly actionable name, and test full-cost recovery before allowing further strategy consideration.
**Finding:** CHIP emerged as the only hedgeable candidate above both gates at +63.84% funding APR and $9.65M OI, with a 92.99% cushion over the $5M floor. Fresh Hyperliquid/Binance depth measured $1k paired entry cost at 9.78 bps, paired exit cost at 18.36 bps, and total depth round trip at 28.14 bps; adding the frozen 29 bps fee allowance produces 57.14 bps known cost and 78.70 hours of break-even before borrow and basis risk. At $5k, recovery stretches to 105.42 hours. Even the optimistic history proxy remains -11.13 bps at 24 hours on the base tier and -5.01 bps on the diamond perp-fee tier, before spot fees, borrow, and basis changes. Continuous-model coverage remains one qualifying date versus three required.
**My thinking:** CH
